text: katamañca saññojanaṃ . santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā . ime vuccanti bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ .pe. santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā .pe. santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā . ime vuccanti bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojananti . navamaṃ . [190] upādāniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi upādānañca taṃ suṇātha . katame ca bhikkhave
